source: Hand-entered; every row names its reference. Galactic (l, b) are degrees, distances Mpc from the Sun (H0 = 70 km/s/Mpc where converted from cz).

structures.name: Great Attractor
structures.source: Lynden-Bell et al. 1988, ApJ 326, 19 (l 307, b 9, cz 4350 km/s); Kocevski & Ebeling 2006, ApJ 645, 1043; distance and mass order of magnitude only

structures.name: Norma Cluster (Abell 3627)
structures.source: Kraan-Korteweg et al. 1996, Nature 379, 519; Woudt et al. 2008, MNRAS 383, 445 (cz 4871 km/s, mass ~1e15 Msun); distance = cz / 70

structures.name: Shapley Supercluster
structures.source: Shapley 1930; Raychaudhury 1989, Nature 342, 251; Proust et al. 2006, A&A 447, 133 (core z ~0.048, mass several 1e16 Msun)

structures.name: Virgo Cluster
structures.source: Position: the galaxies module's M87 (Celestia catalogue); mass: Fouque et al. 2001, A&A 375, 770

structures.name: Laniakea Supercluster
structures.source: Tully, Courtois, Hoffman & Pomarede 2014, Nature 513, 71. Outline here is a stylised lumpy ellipsoid (centre half-way to the Great Attractor), not the measured basin surface

structures.name: Local Group motion relative to the CMB
structures.source: Kogut et al. 1993, ApJ 419, 1 (COBE dipole in the Local Group frame: 627 +/- 22 km/s toward l 276, b 30)
